In Technology & SaaS, blockchain & digital trust delivers distributed-ledger programs where shared truth has economic value: enterprise dlt networks for multi-party workflows, asset tokenization, smart contract engineering and audit, provenance and traceability, decentralized identity with verifiable credentials, and on-chain analytics for compliance. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: enterprise dlt network engineering, asset tokenization & digital assets, smart contract engineering & audit — delivered on Achala Ledger and Achala Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Multi-sided marketplaces lack portable reputation/credential layers; verification friction suppresses liquidity.
